title: 第13章 围猎狼王现第14章 血战爆杀
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 天色尚未破晓，林夜已经起床，穿好衣服出门。
院子里点着灯，常氏在灶房里忙着烧水，张雪在烙饼，空气中弥漫着麦香气。
徐家叔侄也已经起身，正在磨刀。
林大河正在准备麻绳。
林夜匆匆洗了脸，从灶房里端出烙饼和咸菜，给几个人分发。
他自己抓起一张，卷上咸菜就往嘴里塞。
白面饼子，比之前的杂粮饼松软好吃。
他检查了一遍弓箭，将一石强弓和桦木弓全部带上，又收拾出四五十支箭矢，箭袋都鼓鼓囊囊的。
林大河将一把柴刀递给他。
林夜接过看了眼，刀刃崭新，刀口锋利，一看就不是自家那把。
他也没问，将柴刀别在腰间，帮着父亲一起搓着麻绳。
徐林从柴房搬出几捆竹片，擦了把汗。
“这些应该够用了。”
徐虎抽出猎刀，开始削竹片，削出锋利切口。
北方竹子比较脆薄，所以竹片要足够尖锐，否则很难对狼造成什么伤害。
几人忙活了一个多时辰，直到天蒙蒙亮，东西这才收拾停当。
常氏从村里借来一辆板车，几人将竹片麻绳锄头水囊等工具都对了上去。
林夜拉起板车，看了眼神色有些忧虑的林大河，笑道：
“爹，您可得抓紧时间把狼处理了，肉再放一阵子就卖不掉了。”
“行，你不要逞强。”
“嗯，我一定全须全尾地回来。”
说着，他拉动板车出了院子，余光突然扫到一抹身影。
只见张雪柔扶着灶房的门框，露出半截身子，看着自己的眼神也带着几分担忧。
林夜下意识扫了眼她的面板。
好感度赫然达到了“15”。
看来他这三天的努力，张雪柔都看在眼里，好感度已经彻底回升。
短期之内，涨这么多好感，林夜已经心满意足。
他露出灿烂的笑容，朝着张雪柔挥了挥手，头也不回地走了。
出了村，天彻底亮了，只是有些阴沉，云层压得很低。
林夜对这条路线已经十分熟悉，只是板车在林中前行确实要慢很多。
徐虎抬头看了看天，忍不住皱眉。
“看来要下雨，咱们赶紧走，能赶在雨前到了最好。”
几个人加快了脚步，板车在路上颠簸，竹片哗啦啦作响。
走了半个时辰，徐林替下了林夜拉车，剩下两人帮忙推着。
content_en:
;;
Before dawn, Lin Ye had already gotten up, got dressed and went out.
The lamps were lit in the yard, Mrs. Chang was busy boiling water in the kitchen, Zhang Xue was frying pancakes, and the air was filled with the aroma of wheat.
The Xu family's uncles and nephews have also stood up and are sharpening their knives.
Lin Dahe is preparing hemp rope.
Lin Ye washed his face in a hurry, took out pancakes and pickles from the kitchen, and distributed them to several people.
He grabbed one himself, rolled it in pickles and stuffed it into his mouth.
The white flour pancake is softer and more delicious than the previous multigrain pancake.
He checked the bows and arrows, took all the one-stone strong bows and the birch wood bows, and packed out forty or fifty arrows. The quivers were all bulging.
Lin Dahe handed him a hatchet.
Lin Ye took it and looked at it. The blade was brand new and sharp. At first glance, it was not his own.
He didn't ask, he put the hatchet on his waist and helped his father twist the hemp rope.
Xu Lin took out a few bundles of bamboo chips from the woodshed and wiped his sweat.
"These should be enough."
Xu Hu took out his hunting knife and began to peel the bamboo slices, making sharp incisions.
Bamboo in the north is relatively brittle and thin, so the bamboo slices must be sharp enough, otherwise it will be difficult to cause any harm to the wolf.
Several people were busy for more than an hour, and it was not until dawn that everything was put away.
Chang borrowed a cart from the village, and several people loaded it with bamboo pieces, linen ropes, hoes, water bags and other tools.
Lin Ye pulled up the cart, looked at Lin Dahe who looked a little worried, and said with a smile:
"Dad, you have to hurry up and get rid of the wolf. The meat won't be sold if it's kept for a while."
"Okay, don't be brave."
"Well, I'll definitely come back in one piece."
As he said that, he pulled the cart out of the yard, and suddenly saw a figure in his peripheral vision.
I saw Zhang Xuerou holding on to the door frame of the kitchen, half of her body exposed, looking at herself with a bit of worry.
Lin Ye glanced at her panel subconsciously.
The favorability level has reached "15".
It seems that Zhang Xuerou has noticed his hard work in the past three days, and his favorability has completely improved.
In a short period of time, Lin Ye was already satisfied with having gained so much favor.
He showed a bright smile, waved to Zhang Xuerou, and left without looking back.
After leaving the village, the sky was completely bright, but a little gloomy, with low clouds.
Lin Ye was already very familiar with this route, but it was indeed much slower for the cart to move through the forest.
Xu Hu looked up at the sky and couldn't help but frown.
"It looks like it's going to rain. Let's go quickly. It's best if we can get there before the rain."
Several people quickened their pace, the cart bumped on the road and the bamboo pieces rattled.
After walking for half an hour, Xu Lin took over from Lin Ye to pull the cart, and the remaining two people helped push it.
